+# Capture medal goals
+
+F23b replaces the generic faster/cleaner retry suggestion in the existing Solo
+Capture result with the next medal's accepted time target and remaining
+conditions. The existing result summary, stars, picture, actions and record
+owners remain in place. English and Ukrainian use the normal live locale binding.
+The guidance belongs to the existing scrollable Mission details reader rather
+than the optional footer, which compact and short-landscape layouts hide. It
+occupies a complete row in the compact result and uses the existing Read details
+and Done reading controls; it adds no dialog or focus owner.
+
+The projection reads the terminal core medal and effective `run.rules.timeMedals`.
+Bronze targets Silver by time. Silver targets Gold by time and no lost lives.
+Gold reports the highest medal. The comparison retains the core's existing EPS
+acceptance; it never determines or writes the award. Ordinary rules compare
+remaining lives with starting lives, as the core does. Classic rules use
+`classic.livesLost`, so an earned replacement life cannot incorrectly satisfy
+the clean-play requirement.
+
+Authored fractional time targets remain explicit. The UI says when time already
+meets the target. A positive time miss below 0.01 seconds stays visibly positive;
+larger shortfalls round upward to hundredths with that qualification. No damage
+penalty is introduced into Capture. Missing comparison facts are unavailable,
+and nonterminal runs have no medal goal.
+
+Practice keeps its existing no-unlocks footnote, and First Flight retains its
+lesson result owner. Administrative tuning keeps the existing no-award result
+message and suppressed stars, with no medal goal. This feature does
+not change collection, mastery, Journey star or recording eligibility.
+
+The focused tests earn native Gold, Silver and Bronze, verify their recordings,
+repeat a legal loss/extra-life route, and distinguish exact EPS acceptance from
+a positive miss using identical legal cuts. Actual Solo entry tests complete
+normal and administrative flights, preserve the accepted checkpoint, saved
+progress and focused Retry through EN/UK refresh, and exercise the real Retry
+handler. These are source/finite-browser-model checks; actual browser layout,
+physical hardware and comprehension remain separate qualification.
+
+Browser review should complete a normal non-Gold mission, inspect the target
+and time/life conditions at compact width, switch EN/UK, then retry using the
+existing action. Retain the source revision and earned state; any synthetic
+boundary example must be identified separately from the earned flight.

+# FPV / LINE — consolidated improvement and delivery plan
+
+**Review version: 19 October 2026**
+
+## 1. Summary, priorities and current evidence
+
+Improve the existing game in this order: **reliable controls and recovery → clearer first sessions → accessibility and comfort → practice and social play → creation and content discovery → larger platform investments.**
+
+This plan replaces the earlier roadmap, retains **F01–F81**, and incorporates **F82: offline startup recovery** and **F83: controller confirmation reliability**. Each item has a bounded deliverable, expected benefit, estimate and dependency. Split items represent separate complete PRs.
+
+**Execution authorized: 18 October 2026.** Current implementation, evidence, priorities and remaining work are recorded in [the live progress board](progress.md) and [structured tracker](progress.json). Existing local work remains preserved. Physical-device qualification is pending because no iPhone or Steam Deck is available.
+
+**Implementation review update:** **19 merged; 19 feature PRs ready and 29 draft/dependent PRs.** Shared touch-save recovery and Worlds medal guidance are implemented; compact browser review found real Duel Large-pad canvas collapse and Worlds action overlap, so both remain under correction. Text compatibility integration passes its recorded full source gates. Latest Survival suspend integration passes86 combined tests and independent review; its full exact-head gates are pending. Remaining hosts/later phases stay open, and no new live or physical qualification is claimed.
+
+- **F75:** the 30-minute recording cap and the two-hour legacy collection validator have different owners. Authored Journey completion uses separate events; do not imply that every Journey loses progress at two hours.
+- **F82/F14:** the committed package passes desktop missing-module recovery, explicit repair and offline Home startup after full worker activation. Core-only preparation leaves selected Journey artwork unavailable, so full offline gameplay remains unqualified. Readiness must report these separately. A test that removed files during worker activation was invalid and is excluded.
+- **F11a:** include actual backup members and exclusions, using the current Journey export owner added by merged PR #1608. The default authored Journey rejects the older legacy backup set: use an explicit media-only archive capability and disclose excluded legacy game-data/unfinished-flight members; retain import protections.
+- **F09:** enlarge text containers as well as text; retain usable multi-line reading areas, full-width headings/actions and existing reading controls. Current reader findings are usability defects, not a blanket conformance verdict. [W3C text-container guidance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/general/G179.html).
+- **F15b:** current display/input owners already handle several save failures. The first independent fix targets continuous-play settings, where a failed write is silent and an unrelated tab change can erase unsaved intent. Wider and Demo-dependent integration remains tracked.
+- **Delivery:** default package size exceeds the main Pages budget; the prepared deployment inventory must be measured separately. Do not relax limits or delete historical assets to turn this into a pass.
+
+### Changes from the previous plan
+
+| Change                                                              | Reason                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| Move **F83** into the first implementation lane                     | The automated failure reproduces on clean main. Investigation traced its wait to a replaced fixture clock; correct test timing without weakening input assertions. The physical Deck report remains open. |
+| Start **F82** alongside early menu fixes                            | Missing cached startup files can prevent players reaching the existing repair tools.                                                                                                                      |
+| Expand **F14** into readiness UI plus a separate qualification task | Download verification and an installed icon do not establish successful iPhone offline cold launch.                                                                                                       |
+| Keep **F11** at **6–10 days total**                                 | Mobile export/return handling belongs within the archive and restore work; do not estimate it twice.                                                                                                      |
+| Keep **F09** at **6–10 days total**                                 | The estimate includes shared/Solo support and the remaining game families.                                                                                                                                |
+| Separate **F57/F60 evidence from fixes**                            | Existing lifecycle and audio protections should be preserved. Only demonstrated failures justify additional repair work.                                                                                  |
+| Clarify **F28** coverage                                            | Shared touch placement and FPV’s separate dual-stick controls are different deliverables.                                                                                                                 |
+| Clarify **F68** native scope                                        | The current bounded native candidate is simulator-only. Full-game distribution needs a separate content-delivery assessment.                                                                              |
+
+### Audit evidence and limits
+
+This table records the initial audit. Subsequent implementation evidence and exact candidate identities are maintained on the live progress board.
+
+| Area                     | Current evidence                                                                                                                              | Interpretation                                                                                             |
+| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| Game journeys            | Representative browser exploration across Capture, Snake, Survival/Raid, Hunt, SIM, Team/Duel, settings, demos, collections and content tools | Supports the identified UX findings; does not establish completion of every mission                        |
+| Responsive layouts       | Safari previews at 390×844, 844×390 and 1280×800                                                                                              | Sampled screens remained usable; real touch, handheld readability and device performance remain unverified |
+| Offline/install behavior | Source review and 122 passing focused automated tests                                                                                         | Existing protections work in the tested models; installed iPhone cold launch remains unqualified           |
+| Touch/display/audio      | Source review and 134 passing focused automated tests                                                                                         | No basis for rebuilding existing protections; acoustic quality and real interruptions need separate checks |
+| Deck confirmation        | Targeted test file: 10 passed, 1 failed; failure reproduced on supported Node versions                                                        | Confirmed automated regression; relationship to the physical Deck report remains unproven                  |
+| Physical devices         | None available                                                                                                                                | Record device scenarios as **Not tested**, never Passed                                                    |
+
+The game already provides substantial functionality: detailed mission rules, achievement requirements, safe-area handling, touch cancellation, reduced motion, audio-resume paths, verified downloads, repair, writer protection and migration safeguards. Improvements should extend these systems.
+
+### Priority and estimate conventions
+
+- **P1:** correctness, progress protection, access and significant first-session friction.
+- **P2:** learning, comfort, replayability, creation and community participation.
+- **P3:** optional expansion or larger operational investment.
+- **Impact:** expected **player/game** benefit, using **H**igh or **M**edium. These are prioritization judgments, not measured retention results.
+- **Effort:** developer working days including focused verification. Hardware waiting, review queues, external accounts, substantial asset production and ongoing curation are excluded.
+- Phase numbers group outcomes. **Independent P1 work can begin across phases simultaneously.**
+
+Research informs the approach: contextual teaching from [Factorio](https://www.factorio.com/blog/post/fff-361), interruption-friendly progression from [Returnal](https://blog.playstation.com/2021/10/26/returnal-2-0-update-brings-suspend-cycle-and-photo-mode/), configurable presentation and redundant cues from the [Xbox Accessibility Guidelines](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xbox/accessibility/guidelines), and complete focus behavior from [W3C dialog guidance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/). These patterns require validation in this game.

+Create the feature/PR tracker and identify the existing shared-demo work as an explicit predecessor, called **D** below. A finding fixed upstream becomes **Superseded with evidence**; it does not generate an unnecessary PR.

+Use one isolated branch/worktree per PR, with at most **three implementation PRs active** and one integration owner. Assign shared menus, localization registries, generated assets and common styles to a coordinated owner.

+Each PR must deliver a complete usable slice: behavior, UI, English/Ukrainian copy, persistence, failure handling and relevant verification. Assessment PRs deliver evidence and a bounded specification; they do not count as shipped features.

+Keep review candidates as drafts. Repository automation can merge eligible non-draft PRs and publish changes, so draft promotion and release readiness must remain deliberate.

+## 4. Verification and device acceptance
+
+Every PR records **Passed, Failed, Skipped/Waived and Not tested** separately against the actual candidate revision. A green aggregate check is insufficient when underlying tests were skipped.

+### Core acceptance scenarios
+
+- **Navigation:** pointer, keyboard and available controller paths; nested Back; opener focus; no underlying game resume.
+- **F81:** Collection → Achievements → Records → return, then actually open recovery; repeat through Saves & recovery.
+- **F83:** native-first/gamepad-first activation, rapid taps, long holds, Back transitions, reconnect and independent touch/trackpad recovery.
+- **Practice:** move → pause → resume → return to demo → exit; no rewards, input leakage or lost paused state.
+- **Search:** restrictive filters, no matches, no installations, service failure, reversed response order and query changes during pagination.
+- **Storage:** interrupted writes, quota failure, another writer, corrupt/incompatible files, partial restore and reconnect repair.
+- **Presentation:** narrow/short viewports, 200% text, English/Ukrainian labels, visible focus and reachable essential controls.
+- **Gameplay:** complete representative attempts, deterministic checks where relevant, and correct reward/record classification.
+- **Audio:** listening plus lifecycle checks; source inspection cannot establish mix quality.
+- **Online:** controlled two-client journeys with delay, loss, disconnect and service failure.

+| **iPhone Home Screen PWA**       | Install and prepare inside the installed app; force-quit; airplane mode with Wi-Fi off; cold icon launch; finish a previously unvisited prepared mission; verify rewards/progress; repeat after reboot. |
